theory.say:

• Ask for the carrier's reasons in writing; a named reason can be answered, a vague one cannot
• Four elements every suit proves: duty, breach, causation, damages, each backed by a checked exhibit

theory.say:
• Two families of bottlenecks
• Compromise traps stall a mediation: an unverified ledger (unchecked bill list), a representative without authority to pay, a late brief
• Trial-ready landmines can sink a binding arbitration: excluded exhibits, unprotected prior records, missed cutoffs
• Prior medical shield: answering old records, said to show wear and tear, with records and a doctor's opinion
• Two habits clear most early: the 48-hour audit, checking every lien against insurance payment statements

frame.say:

• Arbitration: evidence exclusion from missing documents or black-and-white prints

• The unverified ledger costs most; an unscanned record doesn't exist yet

• Hon. Carla Benton (Ret.), chosen from four windows collected 12/17, Thursday 03/18/2027 at 9:30 a.m., in person at her office
• Statement and binder due 7 days before; John Doe must attend
• 12/10 order of referral: each party and lead counsel attend; Keystone sends someone with full settlement authority
• Fees split equally, firm's half $1,200.00; "completed by 03/31/2027" already calendared

• Verify the trigger, the document a deadline counts from; 03/18 sits 13 days inside 03/31: link it, close the windows task
• Enter the session with attendees; count back: binder 03/11, approval 03/09, binder QC 03/04, draft index 03/02
• Count forward to the mediator's report on 03/25; get John's written confirmation and reminders; cost task for $1,200.00
• Flag: Harbor Point and Cardinal State must consent in writing before any BI settlement

• John's confirmation requested today, tickler 01/15

check.ask: Why is there no calendar entry for the award date?

why.say:
• A carrier starts valuing John Doe's injury the day he walks into urgent care, not at the demand
• Everything paid is argued from the treatment record: how he was treated, how steadily, what doctors found
• Every visit documented and every gap answered, or the gaps surface in the adjuster's offer letter
• Red flag: a claimed harm with no dated record behind it can't be shown in the binder; flag it to Atty. Thorne, never argue it

theory.say:
• MMI (Maximum Medical Improvement) is the trigger: bills stop growing and the prognosis is known
• Objective findings carry the weight: an MRI line beats a paragraph about pain
• Continuity of care: steady treatment reads as real injury; every gap needs its answer on file
• Special damages are billed hard costs; pain, prognosis and future care live in the narrative

rules.say:
• MMI 06/12/2026, Dr. Reyes's Causation Letter 06/19, BI demand 07/20
• The 03/13 MRI: C5-C6 herniation with no significant degeneration next to it; that line is quoted
• The fourteen-day gap and the April disruption were answered on file before Keystone's offer cited them
• Specials $16,401.40, billed and audited
• Repeat injections Dr. Reyes mentioned go in the narrative, note quoted, never in the Specials

job.say:
• MMI declared: close the chronology, audit the Specials in the CMS and Net Sheet, every bill tied to a dated record
• Gap or missed visit: pair it with its documented reason the same week in Case Notes and the Gap Explanation Record
• Demand or binder assembled: map each claim to its proving record in the Packet Builder
• No figure or finding goes out without its source
job.ask: What would you check first if a binder's damages tab didn't tie to the Specials?

case.say:
• 10/23/2026, 2:00 p.m.: Track A's money went out yesterday; the closing letter goes to John today
• Lien file finished: Peach State accepted $1,240.00 in writing; Riverton Spine & Rehab sent its Payoff Letter
• Vance and Kettering's charging lien came in, was repudiated and withdrawn
• This week a colleague tidying shared folders deleted a lien folder from a case backup; nobody noticed

task.say:
• In own Google Drive, delete Liens and Reimbursement from John's folder, on purpose
• Open My Backup Drive, run Check my drive, read what's missing and why it matters
• Use Put the missing folders back; re-run the check until nothing is missing
• File in the CMS from Work From: Peach State's acceptance, Riverton's Payoff Letter, three prior-attorney lien documents to Liens and Reimbursement
• Cost ledger and closing letter to Wages and Costs; Case Note on what was missing and restored

check.say:
• First check named Liens and Reimbursement missing; folder put back; second check clean
• All five lien documents in Liens and Reimbursement
• Cost ledger and closing letter in Wages and Costs; backed-up count matches what was filed
• Case Note: what was lost, how it was found, what was restored
• A lien is closed only when its written answer is on the file and the backup
